$comment: Project settings. There are deliberately NO hooks here. The shell guards that used to run from scripts/claude/ were removed on 2026-08-14: deciding what a shell command will write by parsing its text is undecidable, four rounds of fixes each closed real bypasses and each following round found more, and over a full day they caught none of the real defects - a privilege escalation, a check-then-act race, an unclamped API-key role - every one of which came from an agent or a review bot attacking the work. The review process in CLAUDE.md and review.md is what works and is what is kept, together with .githooks/pre-push, which git hands already-resolved refs so it is not guessing. Install that with 'make hooks'.
$comment_deny: The deny rules below are written as Edit(...) and that is NOT a narrowing to the Edit tool: a path denied here is refused for Write and NotebookEdit too. Checked on 2026-08-12 by attempting a Write to apps/api/internal/db/sqlc/ and a Write to apps/web/src/routeTree.gen.ts; both were refused with 'File is in a directory that is denied by your permission settings', and both shapes are covered - the ** prefix rule and the single-file rule. None of this reaches a Bash write: a shell redirect into a generated tree is NOT blocked by anything here, and since the guards were removed nothing else blocks it either. Regenerate those trees, never hand-sync them - a hand-sync of the sqlc tree caused a production 500.
